name: Tanya Stark
source: Personal maid of Queen Sofia and former maid of the protagonist's family long time ago. She appears in front of the protagonist again to inform him about the truth of his origin and give him the duty to impregnate the Queen as it's the will of the former King to preserve his bloodline. She is also the protagonist's first love.
